branch_policy.reason: The Emergent container uses git default branch 'master'. There is NO 'origin' remote configured inside the container; outbound sync to GitHub (which may use 'main' as default) is handled by the Emergent platform auto-commit/auto-sync layer, NOT by the working agent.
branch_policy.public_repo_branch_may_be: main (or master) depending on platform sync target
branch_policy.discrepancy_resolution: If a public GitHub branch (typically 'main') appears stale relative to in-container files, the agent must NOT attempt manual `git remote add origin` + `git push`. The correct path is to wait for the platform auto-sync or call support_agent. Discrepancies that block validation should be raised to the user with: MD5 of the in-container file + git rev-parse HEAD + an excerpt to prove the local state is correct.
truthful_proof_requirements_on_request: md5 of in-container file via md5sum
git remote -v output (often empty in container)
file content excerpt grep for key tokens

git_state_proof_command: cd /app && md5sum frontend/app/soul-forge.tsx backend/battle_engine.py backend/.env && git rev-parse HEAD && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
